How a cell is built from N, D, and seeds

A cell is one fixed pair (N sheep, D dogs). The runner runs every combination N x D. Each cell is repeated with many seeds (different random starts) to estimate R.
n_cells = (number of N) x (number of D)
n_trials = n_cells x (seeds per cell)
